svg.title: Tutorial room 1.07, the last Friday of term, 16.58
svg.desc: A university corridor and tutorial room with chairs in a circle, a mark sheet with a blank row, a noticeboard with a deadline and one person in the corridor.

g.text: Tutorial room 1.07, the last Friday of term, 16.58
Twelve things to find. Four are the story as it was planned. Four are the story as it came out.
the corridor, one person in it
the library, where the gap is as long as you want
the office, and a deadline on Friday
the stairwell, where he timed it
Thanh, eleven sheets in a bag
Priya, a mark sheet with a blank row
an essay with a comment on page nine
a coffee cup with the name spelled wrong
